description.value: Park Inn Golden is a branded hotel (Park Inn by Radisson) situated on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden, BC, formerly known as the Selkirk Inn. Golden is a gateway to Yoho and Glacier National Parks and a popular overnight stop for cyclists traversing the Rockies or riding the TransCanada route. The hotel sits at the edge of town with easy highway access for loaded touring bikes.
